title_zh: 改约带合适器材检查松动雨槽

scenario.label_zh: 因器材不合适改约雨槽检查
scenario.goal_zh: 发现现有梯子不适用后停止登高，约定维修人员携合适设备检查并先提供费用说明

context_zh: 英国住户奥利与维修人员萨娜在地面上查看雨槽；不提供登高维修操作指导。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Ollie
sentences.text: That section of gutter looks loose. Could you use the ladder in my shed to have a look?

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Not that one; its side is bent. And please don't lean it against the gutter.

sentences.speaker: Ollie
sentences.text: I thought the job would only take a minute. Is there anything in your kit that could hold it in place?

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: I can't judge the repair from the ground, and I haven't brought the right access equipment today.

sentences.speaker: Ollie
sentences.text: Then let's leave it alone. Can you return with what you need?

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Yes, on Thursday morning. I'll explain the inspection charge and any labour costs before you agree to further work.

sentences.speaker: Ollie
sentences.text: Thursday suits me. I'll keep the area below it clear until you've inspected it.

sentences.speaker: Sana
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll send the appointment details and inspection price this evening.

targets.sense_zh: 维修工作中的人工劳动
